Mira: Quick update from bring-up. Ran speculative decoding on draft-x-70b-4q with early-accept heuristic. Observed ~1.7x wall-time speedup but quality drop on multi-turn QA (TriviaQA EM down ~3.2%).
Sam: Nice. what's the exact speculative config? k / accept threshold?
Mira: k=2, accept_threshold=0.65 (softmax-prob based). fallback is greedy decode. Quantized model using nf4-like 4-bit recipe.
Anya: 0.65 feels low. 0.8 should be safer but will reduce perf. Did you sweep?
Mira: Quick sweep: 0.7 -> 1.5x speedup, TriviaQA -1.1% EM. 0.8 -> 1.2x, -0.2% EM. 0.6 -> 1.8x, -4.1% EM.
Kai: Any per-layer acceptance stats? KV cache mismatch could bias late tokens.
Mira: We instrumented per-layer KV acceptance. Early layers ~98% accept, final 4 layers drop to ~82% under the draft/verifier mismatch.
Mira: Run command + perf log:
```
./run_speculative --model draft-x-70b-4q --k 2 --accept 0.65 --batch 8 --seq 512
Throughput: 42 toks/s (baseline 25 toks/s) -> 1.68x
Latency p95: 320ms (baseline 480ms)
```
Sam: Where did regressions concentrate? long-context retrieval, multi-hop, hallucinations?
Mira: Mostly short QA and some multi-turn factuals. Verifier prefers longer token paths but draft proposals get accepted early and cut off the correct continuation.
Anya: Could be cross-entropy drift between the proposal (draft) and verifier. Do you have CE drift per token window?
Mira: Yes. Delta CE (verifier - draft) for tokens 6-20 increases ~0.4 nats on average for the problematic queries; tokens 1-5 are close.
Kai: Proposal: add tiny reranker/check stage for answers below a confidence band. A small dense model as a fast verifier could catch these.
Mira: Agreed. Also want to test higher temp for proposal decode (increase diversity -> reduce false early accepts).
Sam: Ops note: in Dedicated, speculative buffers multiple candidate streams—watch GPU memory and request buffering.
Mira: Action items:
- Mira: full threshold sweep (0.6,0.65,0.7,0.75,0.8) across TriviaQA, NQ, internal regressions.
- Kai: instrument per-layer KV accept rates + CE drift logging.
- Anya: prototype tiny reranker and add to canary pipeline.
- Sam: add eval harness to log accepted vs fallback ratios per API route and model.
Mira: Baseline artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-spec-experiments/draft-x-70b/2141002345/ (perf.json, eval.tsv, logs.tar.gz)
Anya: please put eval logs under /evals/speculative/ so alerting picks them up :thumbsup:
eval-bot: New artifacts: s3://redwood-spec-experiments/draft-x-70b/2141002345/perf.json (sha256: deadbeef)
devbot: Canary queued: draft-x-70b-4q speculative k=2 accept=0.7 -> ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
